title: A super-constant-degree SoS integrality gap for Unique Games
credit: Barak, Sum-of-Squares open problems (lecture notes); Barak & Steurer 2014, arXiv:1404.5236
plain: Construct Unique Games instances with value <= eps on which degree-d Sum-of-Squares has value >= 1-eps, for some d = omega(1) (any slowly growing function of n), or show degree-O(1) SoS achieves a (1-eps, delta) distinguishing guarantee on all UG instances.
math: (Gap) For every eps>0 there is q=q(eps) such that for every degree D there is a Unique Games instance over [q] with optimum <= eps whose degree-2D SoS (Lasserre) value is >= 1-eps. Claim := Gap; ¬Claim is exactly the algorithmic alternative.
review_note: Context (Nov 2026): OpenAI's preprint "The Unique Games Theorem" proves UGC; together with P ≠ NP this would imply the Claim, but P ≠ NP is not known, so the Claim remains open.
